exact_statement: For actual finite uniform-cube Boolean signs, the following proposed all-degree reference mechanisms cannot uniformly pay cross entropy or their stated majorants by total influence. On F_r=1+A_r(chi_{123}-1), r>=4, all r+3 influences equal delta=2^-r, H/I<4, and the complete derivative row of a data coordinate has all its energy delta at residual degrees >=2, contradicting a proposed all-degree bound 2 delta^2 ln(2/delta). The normalized nonempty product-influence reference Q(S)=prod_{i in S}Inf_i/[prod_i(1+Inf_i)-1] has nonempty cross entropy X/I>=r-2r/(r+3). On even-dimensional quadratic bent signs, B/I=2 while degree-weighted atom entropy/I=n and influence-weighted normalized derivative entropy/I=n-1. More generally, for every rule selecting a complete spectral subprobability reference using only the labeled influence vector and permutation-invariant metadata, for every integer w>=2 some coordinate permutation of OR of 2^w disjoint width-w point conjunctions has CE/I>=w/18. This last assertion also covers nonexchangeable reference rules; it does not exclude function-specific references or retained-KL corrections, and does not disprove FEI.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs, finite uniform cubes, standard physical influence
Entropy and ideal complete subprobability cross entropy in bits; natural logs explicitly ln
Product reference is on nonempty subsets and its actual nonempty spectral mass is retained
Influence-only rule gives the same reference for every Boolean realization with the same labeled influence vector and permitted invariant metadata
Coordinate permutation changes the function, while the equal-influence vector in the stated tribes family is unchanged
No claim that arbitrary conditional-edge references or function-specific spectral references have unbounded cost
refutes: All-degree extension of sparse degree-one derivative suppression
Uniform payment of the normalized product-influence nonempty reference
Uniform payment of all-degree upper-atom/complete-row entropy majorants
Universal complete spectral-reference cross entropy payment using only influences and invariant metadata

exact_statement: For any nonconstant Boolean f on n>=1 declared uniform coordinates, its N positive full-cell conjunctions with pi=2^-n, weights lambda_l=1/N and a common rank order have conditioned exactly-one-root probability eta=pi/((1+pi/N)^N-1), with exp(-pi)<=eta<=1. Summing their identical one-root/no-child subset laws cancels both gate labels and root rarity up to -log2 eta. A globally uniform common permutation prior gives the complete nonempty subprobability R_sym(A)=eta/[2*s*(s+1)*binom(n,s)], s=|A|>=1, of mass eta*n/[2*(n+1)]. For every probability law P on subsets, the infimum of CE(P,Q) over exchangeable subprobabilities Q is H(|S|)+E log2 binom(n,|S|), whose exact excess over H(P) is sum_s W_s D(P(.|s)||Uniform_s). For the actual balanced Boolean family M_r=y+A_r(z-y), r>=1,p=2^-r,n=r+2, every coordinate is relevant, I=1+r*p, H=(1-p)^2 log2(1/(1-p)^2)+2*r*(2*p-p^2)->0, and W_1=(1-p)^2+p^2. Every exchangeable reference has CE/I>=W_1 log2(r+2)/(1+r*p)->infinity; its best CE is log2(r+2)+o(1). The explicit ordered full-minterm one-root reference with y ranked first and exponent-two subset weights has CE<(639/80)*I<8*I for all r. For a balanced regular core with a desirability order, the same mandatory-one-gate exponent-two reference has mass n/[2*(n+1)] and c_g<=K_ord*I(g), K_ord=3+log2(6)+3*log2(e)<101/10, by the stated regular rank mean. The accepted A012 fresh-activation output construction transfers it with full mass 1-p+p*z and CE=p*c_g+A_r<=K_ord I(F), retaining D(P_F||Q_F)=p D(P_g||R_g). The exponent-two ordered reference is explicitly modified from the original exponent-6/5 PI-J law; this refutes only a universal exchangeable-reference payment, not FEI or an arbitrary function-adapted posterior reference.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean cubes; entropy, CE and all log quantities in bits
All full-cell supports have the same declared coordinate set and a common chosen order
Exactly-one-root/no-child finite-run subreference conditioned on nonempty initial roots
Exchangeable means invariant under all permutations of physical coordinates
Exponent two for the explicit rational ordered-cost repair; the averaged subset identity holds for any exponent >1
Balanced core and fresh independent controls for activation; regular rank mean is a source-bound input only for the stated grouped-gate application
Ideal complete subprobability cross entropy; failure mass retained and single-sample integer-code rounding separate
